**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What the document has:** Section 9 "TRUELINK WARRANTIES" (p0059–p0060) is a pure Y2K date-handling warranty. Section 11 "Standard of Care" (p0069) is a bare covenant to perform with the care TrueLink uses "for its own operations" — no warranty period, no remedy. Section 3 hosting service levels are reasonable-efforts only, and p0042 expressly disclaims any warranty as to transmitted data.
- **Disclaimer check:** p0076 disclaims only implied warranties and opens "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow an express warranty — no carve-out edit needed. It is not full walk-away "AS IS," but there is no conformance warranty and no repair/replace/refund remedy, so fallback fails on every element.
- **Cure:** one `insert_after` p0060 adding a 90-day software conformance warranty, a 30-day services conformance warranty, and a repair/replacement-or-refund remedy — the fallback position, validated `ok:true` with the minimality gate passing.
